row.notes: Recomputes bit 0x800 of car_ctx+0x130. Only when bit 8 is set: gets the car lap records (Sess_LapTimes_GetCarData on (+0x10)+200), collects up to 200 valid laps (elem 200 bytes, xor-obfuscated sector times non-zero, validity bit matches), sorts them by time and takes the best (obfuscated time at +0xa8^+0xb0). With bit 0x10 it estimates the current lap finish from lap progress and vfunc +0x148 of (+0x10)+0xe0, with bit 0x20 it uses vfunc +0x148 alone. Sets 0x800 when there is no valid best lap or the best lap time is greater than the estimate, clears it otherwise. Better context needed: what flag 0x800 is consumed for (likely abort/continue the run).
